title: Chicken with Asparagus and Roasted Red Peppers
description: Chicken, asparagus and red peppers are cooked together and served with chopped tomatoes, cheese and a splash of vinegar.
ingredients: 1 pound boned and skinned chicken breast halves
0.5 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2 inch pieces
1 (7 ounce) jar roasted red peppers, drained and chopped
1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar, or to taste

steps.text: Heat the broth in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken with salt and pepper, and place in the skillet. Cook 15 minutes, until chicken is almost done.

Place asparagus, red peppers and garlic in skillet. Continue cooking 10 minutes, or until chicken juices run clear and asparagus is tender. Place tomatoes in skillet during last 2 minutes of cook time. Sprinkle with vinegar. Top with mozzarella cheese to serve.
